calls.system:

passages provided, and from nothing else. Cite every fact with the number of the passage it

calls.prompt:
Passages:

[1] repair-manual.pdf p.1
Each ticket gets a coloured tag tied to the bail or handle:
Red tag: warranty repair. The claim already has a WC- number from Customer Service.
No charge to the customer, and the return shipping is on us.
Yellow tag: paid repair. The customer has agreed to the bench fee and to an estimate
for parts.
Green tag: Second Light refurbishment. These are returns and trade-ins being rebuilt
for the refurbished shelf. There is no customer waiting, so they are worked after red
and yellow tags.
The bench fee for a paid repair is $25.00 plus parts at the catalogue price of the part. The fee
is waived under warranty. If a yellow-tag repair turns out to need parts beyond the estimate
by more than $10, stop and have Customer Service call the customer before you continue. Do
not guess at what the customer would want.

[2] repair-manual.pdf p.3
The Northstar is our most repaired product by a wide margin, which is a function of how
many we sell and of how it is used, not of any weakness. Nearly every Northstar fault is one
of four things: a clogged generator, a dry pump cup, a torn mantle, or the wrong fuel. Ask
about the fuel first. The Northstar burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline. It does
not burn kerosene, and a tank that has had kerosene in it will have a varnished generator
and a sticky check valve. That is a paid repair even inside the warranty period.
Tools for the Northstar bench: 11 mm and 13 mm open-ended wrenches, the generator
wrench (part T-ND2, the thin 9 mm one with the bent handle), a small flat screwdriver, the
pump cup oil bottle, a nylon brush, and the torque driver set to 2.5 N·m for checking.
Generator tube replacement
The generator (part G-GEN2) is the tube that runs up through the burner and carries fuel
from the tank to the mantles. Signs of a bad generator are a weak yellow flame that will not
steady, pulsing light, and a tank that holds pressure but will not deliver it. The part is
$13.00, so a typical generator replacement on a yellow tag comes to $38.00 with the bench
fee.

[3] warranty.md > Out of warranty
## Out of warranty

Products outside their warranty period, and declined claims, can be repaired by the Repair Center
for a fee. The customer is quoted before any work is done and can decline the quote, in which
case the product is returned at the customer's shipping cost. The Repair Center's own manual
describes the fee schedule and the shop procedures.

[4] customer-service-playbook.md > Warranty claims
## Warranty claims

The standard warranty is 2 years from the purchase date and covers manufacturing defects. The
Sentinel 1000 and Sentinel 1000 Pro carry 5 years, the Heritage No. 7 carries 10 years,
rechargeable batteries and battery packs carry 1 year, and Second Light refurbished items carry
1 year. Mantles, globes, wicks, bulbs and fuel caps are consumables and are not covered. Drops,
water beyond the IP rating, unapproved fuel, modifications and commercial rental use are not
covered.

A customer starts a claim by emailing help@lanternsupply.example with the order number and
photos. Open a warranty claim in the Hearth admin; it issues a number in the form WC-xxxxxx, for
example WC-030517. The Repair Center decides within 5 business days whether to repair or replace,
and the choice is ours. For an approved claim, send the customer a prepaid label to the
Hagerstown Repair Center at no charge. A claim with no order number can be matched by email
address or by the serial number on the base of the lantern.

The warranty transfers with a gift but not with a resale. If a customer bought the item second
hand, explain this and offer a paid repair.

Lantern Supply Co. Repair Center Bench
Manual
Last updated: September 8, 2026 Owner: Walt Brannigan, Head of Repairs
This manual is for the technicians at the Repair Center, 1180 Downsville Pike, Dock B,
Hagerstown. It covers intake, the bench rules, and the service procedures for every current
product and for the Beacon 400, which we discontinued in March 2025 and still repair while
parts last. Read the whole manual before your first unsupervised bench day. If a procedure
here disagrees with the product's own service bulletin, the bulletin wins; tell Walt so the
manual gets fixed.
Intake
Every lantern that comes through Dock B gets a repair ticket before anyone touches it. Ticket
numbers are RT- followed by five digits (for example RT-20931) and are issued by the intake
terminal. The ticket records the customer's name, the order number if there is one, the
model, the serial number from the base plate, the fault as the customer described it, and the
condition on arrival, including scratches, dents and missing parts. Photograph every lantern
from the front and from the base before you open the box flaps the rest of the way.

Question: My Northstar is out of warranty. What does it cost just to have the bench look at it?
calls.reply: I don't know. The passages give the bench fee for a paid repair ($25.00 plus parts) [1], but none of them mention a charge just to look at or inspect a product.
